caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile with a repeating pattern in red and off-white colors. The main body of the textile features large off-white floral motifs with eight petals, arranged in a grid against a red background, each surrounded by smaller floral shapes filling the spaces between them. The textile is bordered on the left and lower edge by a band with alternating bird motifs and floral designs, also in off-white against the red background, and a narrow decorative fringe at the very edge. In the lower left corner of the border, there is a rectangular section containing text formed from the negative space, reading: "BERKSHIRE HERENGT CO. L BRAYD." The textile is set against a plain, off-white background, and is framed by a simple red-drawn rectangular border. The drawing shows some irregularity along the left edge, suggesting the textile is unfinished or frayed on that side.
title: Woven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
